prompt: Generate screen: Browse Units — the customer's default landing in "StorageHub", a self-storage rental web app. Top bar: logo, nav "Browse Units" (active, indigo underline) · My Rentals · Support, small indigo role chip "Customer", bell icon with red badge "3", avatar "Lan". Below: a filter bar card with closed dropdowns Type (Indoor/Outdoor/Climate) · Size (3/5/8/12 m2) · Start date (Oct 3, 2026) · Duration (3 months) + primary indigo "Search" button. Results row: count chip "6 units available · live" and sort dropdown "Price: low to high". Then a 3-column unit card grid. Each card: photo placeholder (CSS gradient), monospace code chip, size + type chips, one feature line, price with "/mo" suffix, availability line with small status dot, Book button, and a 3px colored LEFT status bar. Cards: S-1 3 m2 Indoor 450.000 VND/mo Available Oct 3 (green bar); S-3 5 m2 Indoor 345.000 VND/mo Available Oct 3 (green); M-2 8 m2 Outdoor 720.000 VND/mo Available Oct 3 (green); M-5 8 m2 Climate 890.000 VND/mo "Only 1 left" tag (green); L-1 12 m2 Indoor 1.150.000 VND/mo Available Oct 3 (green); L-3 12 m2 Climate 1.280.000 VND/mo "Available Oct 5 · cleaning buffer" (amber bar, outline Book button). Technical SaaS style, Stripe/Linear lineage, light mode, indigo #4F46E5 accent, tabular numerals, money format "1.150.000 ₫".
